_doc: TuRu - USER-FACING BROWSE GROUPS (2026-09-25). A PRESENTATION-ONLY union over canonical categories:
tapping a group sets filters.category to its `members` (canonical strings exactly as stored).
Groups are never stored, never written to activities.category, never sent to ingestion, the
classifier, Smart Search or analytics. Search keeps resolving to canonical values only.
DRIFT GUARD: every value in categoryValues.categories + storageOnlyCategories appears EXACTLY
ONCE, either in one group's `members` or in `internal` (tests/browseGroups.test.js). A new
canonical value therefore fails the test suite until it is assigned here - never a silent fallback.
id           stable ASCII key; the display label lives in lib/i18n/locales/*/domain.json
homeDefault  one of the fixed Home 'מה עוד מעניין אתכם?' tiles. A USER-INTENT choice, never
derived from catalogue counts (coverage is playground-biased by ingestion history).
order        deterministic picker order, independent of translated text.
internal     canonical values that are valid in storage but have no user-facing browse entry
